item.title: Georgia man gets two life sentences for killing pregnant woman
item.description: He killed the victim because she wanted an abortion. The judge said, “When you killed her, then you killed the child. What you were trying to prevent, you did."

item.title: Report: Alaska used tax dollars for elective abortions against federal law
item.description: Media reports indicate that Alaska used federal Medicaid tax dollars to pay for elective abortions for months following enactment of the 'Big Beautiful Bill.'

item.title: 'Dancing on Ice' star's failed IVF attempt led to shocking answer to her 'unexplained infertility'
item.description: Had they chosen more IVF, they never would have had success because of the way her DNA reacts to her husband's — but they never would have understood why.

item.title: Innocence Stolen Twice: Why I fight for trafficking victims and their unborn children
item.description: These girls are told they have no value beyond what someone will pay for them. Then when a life begins inside them, they're told that life has no value either.

item.title: 59-year-old Chinese woman has baby by IVF because she was 'lonely'
item.description: Zou gave birth to a premature baby due to loneliness, and few in the medical community seemed concerned about the long-term future of her baby boy.

item.title: Government underreports 99% of England and Wales abortion pill complications
item.description: The DHSC and NHS 2023 statistics reports show the government has deliberately excluded more than 99% of abortion pill complications that took place.

item.title: HHS rescinds Biden-era guidance that pressured pharmacists to offer abortion pills
item.description: (LifeSiteNews) The Trump administration Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) Office for Civil Rights (OCR) is rescinding a Biden-era guidance that attempted to force pharmacists to dispense abortion pills.

item.title: OUTRAGE: Taxpayers are sending billions to the 'nerve center of the abortion industry'
item.description: One expert says that defunding this "mastermind of abortion policy" in the US "would be a significant blow against the nerve center of the abortion industry.”

item.title: Texas AG sues Delaware abortionist for mailing abortion pills into state
item.description: Texas AG Ken Paxton has announced that his office has sued Debra Lynch, a Delaware abortionist responsible for sending abortion pills into the state of Texas.

item.title: Indiana doctor loses license after illegal abortion and sex with patients
item.description: Indiana's AG said a Jasper County physician lost his ability to practice medicine for committing an illegal abortion and having sexual contact with patients.
